derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040sc.pdf (IRS fillable form): for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row) and, for table columns, whose x-band matches the printed column. Checkbox on-states were read from each widget's /AP /N appearance keys with pypdf. TY2025 layout change: line 27a is 'Energy efficient commercial buildings deduction (Form 7205)' and line 27b is 'Other expenses (from line 48)'. The v1 single aggregate expense total therefore goes on Part V (page 2) as one itemized row plus the line 48 total, and on line 27b (f1_39, widget row y-center 246 matches the printed '27b' row) — NOT on line 27a (f1_40). Part II two-column layout: lines 8-17 amounts sit in the left sub-column (Lines8-17, x 194.4-294.45) and lines 18-27 in the right amount column; each field's widget row was matched to its printed label row. Header: proprietor name f1_1 / SSN f1_2 (name row), C business name f1_5 and D EIN comb field f1_6 (second header row). Boxes A/B (principal business/code), E (address), F/G/H/I/J are NOT in this map: not modeled in v1 (see packet manifest notes).

entries.note: Header 'Name of proprietor' field, Rect [36, 684, 445.65, 698]; filled from the stored taxpayer identity when present.
Header 'Social security number (SSN)' field, Rect [446.4, 685, 576, 698]; digits-only; report value masked.
Header box C 'Business name. If no separate business name, leave blank', Rect [36, 635.998, 445.65, 649.999]; filled with the 1099-NEC payer name (the engagement this Schedule C reports).
Header box D 'Employer ID number (EIN)' comb field, Rect [446.4, 635.998, 576, 649.999]; filled with the 1099-NEC payer EIN when one is stored.
Line 1 'Gross receipts or sales' amount field; widget row matches the printed '1' label row.
Line 3 (line 1 minus line 2; line 2 returns/allowances is blank in v1); widget row matches the printed '3' label row.
Line 5 'Gross profit' (line 3 minus line 4 cost of goods sold; line 4 is blank in v1); widget row matches the printed '5' label row.
Line 7 'Gross income' (line 5 plus line 6 other income; line 6 is blank in v1); widget row matches the printed '7' label row.
Part V 'Other Expenses' item 1 description field (page 2); carries the v1 aggregate-expense label.
Part V item 1 amount field (page 2): the engagement's total expenses as a single aggregate (v1 does not itemize expenses).
Line 48 'Total other expenses' (page 2), flows to line 27b; widget row matches the printed '48' label row.
Line 27b 'Other expenses (from line 48)' amount field (page 1); widget row y-center 246 matches the printed '27b' label row.
Line 28 'Total expenses before expenses for business use of home'; widget row matches the printed '28' label row.
Line 29 'Tentative profit or (loss)' (line 7 minus line 28); widget row matches the printed '29' label row.
Line 31 'Net profit or (loss)' (flows to Schedule 1 line 3 and Schedule SE line 2); widget row matches the printed '31' label rows.
